days.label: Today
days.note: 1pm update: swell easing — 168 kJ arvo avg (peak 245) from a 6s NE windswell plus a fading 11s S. NE 18 kph gusting 32 now, swinging N ~29 kph by 3pm — wind-affected everywhere; Long Reef/Curl Curl S ends the only semi-sheltered options. Low tide 7:45pm.
days.surfline_text:
The S swell is easing back but there's still a fun enough chest to head high set across the Sth facing magnets. Light N winds are adding texture to most stretches, it'll be a day for Nth corner protection as we're set to see these winds pick up into midday.  
 
If you're going for the smaller Sth corner breaks, head for the early as later on they'll be looking even more junky and wind affected.
